SideNav: Handovers vs the Nav bar pattern: the Nav bar pattern says Build has no sections and therefore no sidebar, yet the Build handover places `sidebar-organism` on most screens (~1,000 instances). The kit follows the pattern note. Which is right?
PageTop: Two masters in Patterns: standalone `page-top` 95:18889 and component set 244:117279 (set key c5e4c474…). The set's variant and the standalone share key 771d8425…; the set only adds the `cooper` eyebrow and the `show search` / `Show button` booleans. Neither turned up in a search of the published IFS Design System library. The kit follows the set.
The Command instance (244:119970) overrides the row gap to 12 (master 20) and its title row has no button. The kit passes `style={{ gap: 12 }}`.

The Build / Idea Pad page-top (244:120196, 95:106508 and the other Idea Pad frames) is a detached frame, not an instance: title only, description hidden, tabs `Size=L (40)` squeezed to 36. The kit uses `Tabs size="l"` at 40, so the content sits 4px lower.
The Cooper eyebrow uses `cooper-icons State=Insight`; the kit draws `cooper-system-icon` Insight (same artwork). The eyebrow text is `text/tertiary`; the earlier hand-built intro used secondary.
Older instances still hold the legacy `tab` / `counter` / `ai smart search` parts; the set uses `tab` Size=M (36), `counter-atom` S and `smart-search-organism`.
Pattern: Widget builder — Investment ove: Drag visuals: both shown together. The ghost card follows the pointer, and "Drop here to place" marks the target (designer decision). Frames: chip 331:509710, ghost 413:53329.
Source opacity while dragging: the notes say ~30%, the frames draw 40%. The kit uses 30% (notes win).
Ghost width: the notes say "current width", the frames draw ~330px. The kit keeps the full widget width (notes win).
Resize from the ⋮ menu (S/M/L, 331:507578) as well as edge handles (rules 413:44071 mention only handles). Both are built, with the same limits.
Pattern: Report widgets — resize, drag &: Two charts in one row: the old frame 331:507955 shows a resize handle between them; the rules (413:56466) lock them at ½ + ½. The kit locks them (notes win).
PreviewWidgetCard: The Figma previews are raster images; the kit draws blank placeholder blocks.
